title: Hemant Rohera: patent drawing sheets of three granted inventions (eMedica US 12,226,183 B2, Hybrid Power Pack US 10,523,019 B2, OMNIA Drive US 11,117,476 B2)
description:
The drawing sheets of the three granted US patents of Hemant Karamchand Rohera (Hemant Rohera), engineer and inventor, Pune, India, collected in one PDF with an index.

  • eMedica, US 12,226,183 B2 (Medical therapeutic device): Patents granted in the United States, Japan, Korea, Australia, Canada, Saudi Arabia and South Africa, including US 12,226,183 B2.
  • Hybrid Power Pack: US 10,523,019 B2, with grants in India, Europe (DE/GB/CH), Japan, Canada, Eurasia, UAE, Vietnam and Mexico.
  • OMNIA Drive: granted in the US, India and Japan (US 11,117,476 B2 · IN 477613 · JP 7,109,623).

Figure-by-figure explanations: https://hemantrohera.com/hemant-rohera-patent-drawings.html . A granted patent describes an invention and its claims set the scope; it is not a measurement of how a product performs.
